method: Use one manually observed physical ground root and uniform scale per whole object. Crop to alpha>=8 visible bounding box without changing retained RGBA values; faint provider alpha outside the visible object is excluded technically. LANCZOS downsample and integer placement only. No painted pixels synthesized.

targonianStarwayCairn.description: A local pilgrim trail marker below Targon, carved from mountain stone and marked with a regional emblem. Static scenery; it grants no movement, reward or celestial power.
targonianStarwayCairn.name: Targonian Starway Cairn

voidscarOutcrop.description: A small dormant Void-touched outcrop, its narrow scar clogged with dark organic crust. Static scenery; it has no visit, damage, teleport, growth or spawning effect.
voidscarOutcrop.name: Voidscar Outcrop
